ApprovedGenerationInputs.description:
Exact institution-approved inputs from which specialization may derive a generation.

Keeping these axes in one canonical value prevents a commissioner from preserving
the approved model and policy while substituting an adapter, pack, schema, topology,
toolchain, or weaker reproducibility posture during derivation.

adapter_digests.description: Trusted adapters included in the generation.

component_digests.description: Other exact executable, migration, projection, or update components.

excluded_commissioning_capabilities.description: Broad commissioning capabilities explicitly absent from this generation.

pack_digests.description: Declarative domain packs included in the generation.

schema_digests.description: Public schemas included in the generation.

specializer_digest.description: Digest of the specialization compiler and its configuration.

toolchain_digest.description: Digest of the exact build toolchain and compatibility inputs.

CommissioningCapability.description: Broad engineering capabilities that an operational generation excludes.

oneOf.description: Editing the institution's approved semantic model.

CommissioningRecordId.description: Identity of one append-only commissioning provenance record.

DeploymentTopology.description: Placement and assurance posture for a deployment.

oneOf.description: Single-operator development with local or in-memory state.
Dedicated client-controlled deployment with durable state.
Isolated deployment with stronger separation of duties and assurance.

InstitutionId.description: Identity of one institution authority domain.

InstitutionWorkspaceId.description: Identity of one institution-owned commissioning workspace.

LifecycleProfile.description: Authority and capability posture during an institution's lifecycle.

oneOf.description: Bounded read-heavy reconnaissance and candidate-model construction.
Explicitly authorized return to broader engineering.

PolicyBundleId.description: Identity of an immutable policy bundle.

ReproducibilityContract.description: Reproducibility posture for a runtime generation.

oneOf.description: Exact inputs must reproduce bit-for-bit identical generation bytes.
Named fields may differ under an exact machine-readable contract.

contract_digest.description: Digest of the contract explaining and constraining those fields.

fields.description: Canonical field paths allowed to vary.

RuntimeGenerationId.description:
Content-derived identity of an immutable runtime generation.

Unlike actor and record identifiers, a generation identity is never random:
the same canonical specialization inputs produce the same identity.

RuntimeGenerationInputs.description: Canonical inputs from which one immutable runtime generation is derived.

approved.description: Exact owner-approved specialization and build plan.

commissioning_record_digest.description: Digest of the exact commissioning record.

institution.description: Institution whose operational generation is being derived.

policy_digest.description: Digest of the exact approved policy bundle.

trust_domain.description: Client-controlled trust domain for the generation.

workspace_digest.description: Digest of the exact workspace snapshot.

TrustDomainId.description: Stable identifier for a client-controlled trust boundary.
